card.name: Maintenance therapy and medical support terms
card.fires_on: The word maintenance itself, or the noun right after it (therapy, treatment, dose), in dosing headings and sentences. It also fires weakly on nouns after 'medical' such as monitoring and support.

modes.label: Maintenance phrase
modes.description: The word maintenance or the noun that follows it, such as therapy, treatment, dose or setting.
modes.example: Maintenance<< Therapy>> — The maintenance dosage of penicill

modes.label: Medical monitoring and support
modes.description: A noun after 'medical' or 'monitoring and' in advice about readily available care.
modes.example: Appropriate medical monitoring and<< support>> measures should be readily available during ALD

card.plain: It marks the long-term maintenance part of dosing text, and sometimes the phrase about medical monitoring and support.
